title: Underived ringed square for native forgetting
statement: For a finite field k0, a prime l different from its characteristic and a k0-scheme X, let B be native Weil module sheaves and A ordinary adic module sheaves [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. A NativeWeilTensorRingedBridge consists of two small ringed sites (J,R),(K,Q), additive equivalences B to Modules(R) and A to Modules(Q), and an additive exact ringed forgetful functor U commuting with these equivalences and native forgetting. U preserves products, coproducts and K-injective complexes. It carries normalized underived tensor, unit, Hom and evaluation comparisons [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data]. The two equivalences carry internal Hom to sheaf Hom, and those comparisons commute with the forgetful square. The native coefficient object maps to R. U carries complexes that are both K-flat and termwise flat to complexes satisfying both conditions. No derived tensor or derived tensor comparison is part of these data.
